name: Photos
description: Aggregated place photos from multiple providers

dataSources.purpose: Place photos resolved from OpenStreetMap image tags (direct image URLs and Wikimedia Commons filenames)
dataSources.dataSent: OpenStreetMap element reference (node/way/relation) or place name and coordinates, used to look up the element's tags
dataSources.dataReceived: OpenStreetMap element tags, including image, image:0..N and related photo references

dataSources.purpose: Link-preview images for places whose OpenStreetMap image tag points to a Google Photos share link
dataSources.dataSent: The Google Photos share URL taken from the place's OpenStreetMap image tag (no user or account data)
dataSources.dataReceived: The Open Graph preview image URL advertised by the share page for embedding
